# Surfacing

> Surfacing is a free mental health symptom tracker for iOS and Android. It covers PTSD, anxiety, depression, OCD, ADHD, BPD, bipolar, grief, and 40+ other conditions. No account, works offline, and all data stays on the user's phone.

Surfacing is built around a simple behavioral practice: when something hits, stop and log it. The check-in (trigger, intensity, what happened, skills used and whether they helped) takes under 30 seconds and is designed to give the user a short, deliberate pause between a trigger and their response, both during an episode and when reviewing patterns between episodes. The same entries become a record a clinician can read: users export a password-protected, self-contained HTML report (charts, filters, full entry history) that opens in any browser, with CSV and AI-readable JSON downloads inside. Surfacing is a personal self-monitoring tool, not a medical device or treatment.

## Free resources
- [Feelings List and Body Map](https://surfacingapp.com/feelings.html): 796 feeling words in 22 categories, plus 243 body sensations grouped by where they are felt. Free to print and share, no sign-up.
- [Surfacing Feelings MCP server](https://surfacingapp.com/mcp.html): free remote MCP server (registry name com.surfacingapp/feelings) that gives AI assistants this same feelings list and body map. Endpoint https://surfacing-mcp.knightcorrick.workers.dev/mcp, Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only, stores nothing.
- [Live sample report](https://surfacingapp.com/sample-report.html): an interactive example of the report a patient can send a clinician.

## About the app
- [For patients](https://surfacingapp.com/patients.html)
- [For clinicians](https://surfacingapp.com/clinicians.html)
- [Privacy and data handling](https://surfacingapp.com/hipaa.html): data is stored on-device only; Surfacing is HIPAA-aligned, not a HIPAA covered entity.
- [Download](https://surfacingapp.com/download.html): App Store and Google Play, free, no paywall.
